checked_sources: independent_checks.py split conditional-azimuth quadrature and exact d=3 threshold asymptotic
correctness.rationale: The cube support function gives W=Σ|Ui|. Each orthant is a spherical cap around v=(1,…,1)/√d, and the cap stays inside the orthant iff its angular radius ≤arcsin(1/√d), i.e. s≥√(d−1); the sphere cap fraction is I_beta/2, multiplied by 2^d orthants. If two different coordinates leave their orthant, ΣUi≤√(d−2), so below the first threshold but above √(d−2) one subtracts d disjoint one-face spherical segments exactly. Parameterizing a face by x<0 and the residual sphere gives aperture²≈2(ε+x)/√(d−1), segment area proportional to ε^(d/2) and coefficient −2^d/π(2/q)^((d−2)/2). In d=3 a spherical cap cut by a great-circle gives explicit segment angles α=acos(s/√(2(3−s²))) and γ=acos(1/√(3−s²)); subtraction yields the stated H3(s); differentiation gives lower density 4/√3(1−3α/π) and upper density 4/√3. My independent conditional-azimuth integral over x=|U1|, split at exact algebraic event thresholds to avoid quadrature endpoint bias, matched H3(s) within 3×10⁻¹⁴ over s=1.001,1.05,1.2,1.4,√2±.001,1.6,1.72. The d=3 normalized near-threshold correction/ε^(3/2) tends numerically 3.0282910514, matching the analytic constant; this tests but does not replace the all-d argument.
residual_risks: Unrestricted cap formula is false below √(d−1) without excluded-segment correction.
Pairwise segment exclusion works only above √(d−2); no entire d>3 low-tail law is claimed.

value.rationale: Directional width is a canonical convex-geometric random invariant. A fully elementary density in dimension three, with an exactly uniform upper-tail interval, and a sharp dimension-parameterized first nonanalytic cap-overlap transition are meaningful exact distributions, not merely re-computations of existing mean/moment tables. The first-transition exponent and coefficient also quantify singularity introduced by crossing coordinate faces.
residual_risks: The prior 2026 general polytope coarea formula is a remaining material coverage comparison; do not assert an unprecedented density without examining it.

final_claim: For uniformly random spherical direction U, the unit cube width W=Σ|Ui| has exact beta-function high tail for s≥√(d−1) in all d≥3, first cap-face correction of order ε^(d/2) with coefficient −(2^d/π)(2/√(d−1))^((d−2)/2), and a full explicit piecewise d=3 survival/density with a constant upper-tail density 4/√3.
limitations: Not an all-d full distribution below √(d−2), only first transition and full d=3.
